entity.name: CODERCOPS
entity.description: CODERCOPS is a small software studio in India. We build and maintain four MIT-licensed developer tools: an embeddable AI chat widget, an OG image generator, a set of in-browser developer utilities, and the bot that runs our contributor community. All of them are free to use and self-host. We don't sell them or a hosted version of them. Close to 60 people have had pull requests merged across the four repos, many of them first-time open source contributors.

projects.name: ChatCops
projects.description: An embeddable AI chatbot widget you add to any website with one script tag. It works with Claude, OpenAI and Gemini, and comes with lead capture, a knowledge base and translations. Published on npm as @chatcops/widget, @chatcops/server and @chatcops/core.

projects.name: OGCOPS
projects.description: A free Open Graph image generator with over 100 templates, previews for 8 platforms and a free REST API. No login and no watermarks.

projects.name: toolbelt
projects.description: Developer tools that run entirely in the browser, so nothing is uploaded: a JSON formatter, JWT decoder, Base64, regex tester, invoice generator and more.

projects.name: CODERCOPS community bot
projects.description: The Cloudflare Worker behind our contributor community. It posts starter issues, releases and merged PRs to Discord and runs the public monthly contributor leaderboard at oss.codercops.com.

channels.description: Bank transfer to our account in India. Write to us for the details.

plans.name: Maintainer time
plans.description: Paid hours for reviewing pull requests, triaging issues, mentoring new contributors and shipping releases across the four projects.

plans.name: Hosting and infrastructure
plans.description: Cloudflare Workers, storage, domains and the AI API usage behind the public demos.
